ep_thinktank_events.title: [related] EP event: Other events - DEVE delegation to Bolivia on 27-29 October 2026 - 27-10-2026 - Development
ep_thinktank_events.description: A delegation of 3 Members, led by MEP Reinhold LOPATKA (EPP), traveled to Bolivia from 27 to 29 October. The purpose of the mission was to review the EU development portfolio in Bolivia, particularly in the context of the current programming period. The mission particularly focused on: - human development issues. Bolivia, a lower-middle-income country, continues to face high levels of economic and social inequality, especially in rural and indigenous areas. ep_thinktank_events.title: [Water Resilience, Water Initiative] EP event: Workshops - New Knowledge and Innovation Community in the field of water, marine and maritime sectors-EIT Water - 09-12-2026 - Scientific foresight
ep_thinktank_events.description: Europe faces growing water stress, droughts, floods and degradation of aquatic ecosystems, made worse by regional disparities and climate change. Research too often fails to become practical solutions and skilled jobs, because efforts are fragmented across regions and sectors. The launch of EIT Water, the new Knowledge and Innovation Community (KIC) on water, marine and maritime sectors, together with the EU Water Resilience Strategy, offers an opportunity to bring innovation, education and entrepreneurship together and speed up Europe’s transition to water and blue resilience.
